representedDate: Main museum standing at its 2025 opening.
wholePhysicalScope: The opened 2025 museum relation gives the 56-point main roof envelope and four-point inner opening. Original relief supplies the plateau and entrance context.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped museum outline, folded gallery roofs and recessed entrance. Close levels refine the stairs, facade panel and concrete surface rhythms.
limitations: The 56-point outside ring and four-point internal opening are mapped. Roof folds, the exact positions of internal stair and structural supports, current glazing colors and facade panel rhythms are estimated from the architect’s and contractor’s written descriptions.

The main grade is varied with the source relief. Heights are estimates constrained by the building relation’s 46-metre label, the architect’s plateau description and the contractor’s documented sections. The original surface model preserves mixed roof and terrain pixels.
The model covers the main museum. The independently mapped Khufu Boat Museum, plaza monuments, artwork and surrounding buildings are outside this structure.
